E2-2022-T3-P1-S5.trunk: S+V+C："Dark patterns" is a catch-all term（“暗黑模式”是一个统称）
structure: 过去分词状语：First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull
主句："dark patterns" is a catch-all term for practices
└ 定语从句(that)：that manipulate user interfaces
└ 目的状语(to)：to influence the decision-making ability of users
E2-2022-T3-P1-S5.logic: 句首过去分词补充术语的提出背景；主句定义概念；that 从句说明这些 practices 做什么，不定式进一步说明操纵界面的目的。
notes: coin 作动词表示“创造、首创（新词）”。
catch-all term 指覆盖多种现象的概括性名称。
decision-making ability 是复合名词，指作出决定的能力。

E2-2022-T3-P1-S11.trunk: S+V：Businesses should engage..., and include...（企业应展开讨论，并让相关人员参与）
structure: 谓语1：should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams
└ 目的状语(to)：to review their privacy policy
并列谓语2(and)：include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders
├ 形容词短语：responsible for the company's user interface
└ 并列宾语(as well as)：the marketers and advertisers
└ 形容词短语：responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions
E2-2022-T3-P1-S11.logic: should 同时支配 engage 与 include 两个动作；后半句宾语很长，被两个 responsible for 短语分别限定。识别两个并列谓语和两组人员即可拆开长句。
notes: compliance 在企业语境中指合规职能。
include in the discussion... 是宾语后移结构。
as well as 在此补充第二组参与者。

E2-2022-T3-P1-S17.trunk: S+V：Dark patterns can be addressed, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable（暗黑模式可以治理，但前提是组织自我负责）
structure: 主句：Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self-regulatory basis
限制条件(but only if)：but only if organizations hold themselves accountable
└ 相关对象并列：not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards
E2-2022-T3-P1-S17.logic: 主句提出行业自律这一途径；but only if 强化必要条件；not just...but also...把责任范围从最低法律要求扩展到更高的行业实践和标准。
notes: on a self-regulatory basis 意为“以行业自律方式”。
hold oneself accountable 表示主动承担责任、接受问责。
not just A but also B 是递进并列，不应漏译 B。
